By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Optimous|Optimous]] ([[User_talk:Optimous|Talk]]) 05:12, November 20, 2009

== Blog posts ==

Let me know if you have any questions. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 21:01, November 21, 2010 (UTC)

Okay, no problem. [[User:Terez|Terez]] 21:24, November 21, 2010 (UTC)
:I know you haven't done any blog post entries in a while, but for right now we're putting a hold on them (see [[Wotwiki:Copyrights]] for more information).
